Ah! That's father! What exactly happened?
See, I told you so many times not to eat things\noff the ground...
T-there are 2 fathers?! What's going on?!
Anyhow, we need to defeat father to save father!\nI'm counting on you!
Finally? You beat father...

You don't have to call!
You don't have to beg!
Here I come!! Zarth, the King of Halloween!
Father, once again I ask, what happened?
Hm! As usual I was checking the stuff I brought\nfrom another world, and there was something that\nclones the power of the person who held it!
I ran out of energy while trying to hold the clone\nof myself down that suddenly appeared.
I'm glad you came to rescue, Jeila...and, hm?
How is this person related to you?
This person is a guest.\nHe came here for fun.
Whaaaat?!\nYour relationship with my daughter is just for\nfunnn?!
Stop talking nonsense, father.\nLet's go home, mother is worried.
Okay!
What?! I thought your clone has been defeated?!
You silly!
This is me!
The real me!
...Then? What are you doing, father?
Okay, calm down my daughter.\nViolence won't solve anything, right?
Actually, I'm curious about the true power of the\nguest who beat my clone.
Since my wife and daughter said that it's really\namazing, I kinda want to have a showdown with\nthe guest!
Jeez. You shoulda said it when you told us to\nexplore this place.
I just realized after a while! So, are you ready?
Jeez, I knew it would turn out like this when you\njust disappeared like that...
Ah, mother. You came to stop this, right?\nWhat would you do?
My dear husband! Do your best!
What? Mother?!
It's been a while since I last saw that person's\ntrue power, so I kinda wanna see it again.\nYou've never seen it either, have you?
Ooh! Come to think of it, no, I have not.\nNow I wanna see it!
Father, that person is really strong!!
Zarth, go for it!
But the guest is powerful too.
Good luck to both of you, pom!
Aight, let's do this!
H-how could you...?!\nYou're the 29th person that withstood that attack\nof mine.
That's too many, father.
Wait? Maybe 30...\nOr perhaps more than 40?
Whatever.\nBut still, my dear husband, you're great. I didn't\nexpect you to last that long against the guest.
Second that.\nYou were awesome, father!
You're strong, Zarth!\nIt was amazing that you lasted that long against\nthe guest.
Zarth, you were extraordinary!
I was nervous and my heart was pounding while\nwatching, pom!
Of course!
Cuz I am!
The King of Halloween!
If only he could fix that attitude...
That battle was intense.\nThanks! Please take this as a token of my\ngratitude.

Although we have troubled you so much too this\ntime, I'm glad you said so.
Oh yeah, actually there's still a sweets recipe\namong the stuff my husband brought from another\nworld.
I think I can make them pretty easily.\nThe only problem is that with just the ingredients\nhere, only a little can be made.
So, I'm thinking of asking you to collect some\nmore ingredients...What do you say?
All right.
Maybe next time.

All right then, I won't force you since I have\ntroubled you so much. But if you change your mind,\nplease let me know.

No problem. I'm the one asking for help.\nJust take your time.
Ooh, you've gathered the ingredients.\nYeah, everything is just right...
With this I'll be able to make a lot of sweets for\nJeila and the other kids.
I tried making this earlier and it turned out to\nbe good. Please take it as a thank-you gift.
